title: A Ember for the Choir
author: Paloma Oyelaran
blurb: Gideon Quintana, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
